name: All Hands and Hearts
story: $1,000 funds disaster relief at home and abroad, and every **{us: cost_total / households_reached|$}** cleans out or repairs one storm- or fire-hit home in the US.
summary: Volunteers led by its staff muck out, sanitise and repair disaster-hit homes in the US, rebuild schools after disasters in Nepal, the Philippines and Mexico, and fund relief through local partners.

spending.source: https://allhandsandhearts.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/All-Hands-and-Hearts-2025.pdf (audited statements, year to 31 August 2025, pp. 4-5: program expenses $12,794,832, including $1,636,362 of donated goods and services, note 10). The Form 990 (https://allhandsandhearts.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/All-Hands-and-Hearts-Smart-Response-2024-990-PDC.pdf, Part III) books $12,523,438 without donated services: Hurricane Helene in North Carolina $2,700,913, Helene and Milton in Pasco County, Florida $2,364,662, the Los Angeles wildfires $1,363,557 and other programs $6,094,306.

lines.label: US disaster response and home repairs (Helene, Milton, the Los Angeles fires, the Texas floods and others)
lines.source: https://allhandsandhearts.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/All-Hands-and-Hearts-2025.pdf (audited programme expenses $12,794,832, year to August 2025) times one minus the share abroad (@all_hands_and_hearts.intl_spend_share, best 0.18, our judgment: neither the statements nor the Form 990 split spending by country) = $10,491,762. The Form 990's three named programmes, all in the US ($6,429,132), are inside this line.

lines.label: School rebuilds and disaster relief abroad (Nepal, the Philippines, Mexico, Myanmar)
lines.source: https://allhandsandhearts.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/All-Hands-and-Hearts-2025.pdf (audited programme expenses $12,794,832, year to August 2025) times the share abroad (@all_hands_and_hearts.intl_spend_share, best 0.18, our judgment) = $2,303,070, inside the Form 990's 'other programs' ($6,094,306).
